title: TALON：面向放射报告生成的时间感知纵向框架
summary: TALON是一个时间感知的纵向放射报告生成框架，通过双通道时间融合模块（DCTFM）自适应整合变长患者病史，利用相似性与变化双通道比较当前与历史检查，并通过通道专属注意力和门控机制筛选有效纵向证据。在MIMIC-CXR上超越现有最优方法，且历史检查越多性能越好。
summary_en: TALON is a Temporally Aware LONgitudinal radiology report generation framework that adaptively integrates variable-length patient histories. Its Dual-Channel Temporal Fusion Module (DCTFM) compares the current exam with each prior exam via complementary similarity and change channels, using channel-specific attention and learned gates to capture persistent findings and interval changes while suppressing redundancy. On MIMIC-CXR, TALON outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with performance improving as more prior exams become available.
